description: This source file contains Python test code for verifying the functionality of a project initialization framework that generates TypeScript projects based on templates. It includes fixtures for setting up temporary directories and mock templates, as well as multiple test functions that validate template info retrieval, project creation, script execution, config loading, and variable substitution.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and cleans up a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a mock TypeScript template directory with configuration and source files.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a sample project configuration object for testing.

methods.name: test_typescript_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that retrieving template initialization info correctly extracts configuration commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that initializing a project generates the expected directory structure and file content.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Test that the post-processing script runs successfully, e.g., by creating a marker file.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Test that project configuration can be loaded correctly from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that template variables within files are correctly replaced with project metadata during initialization.
